kinds.PROVEN: mathematical theorem, proved or recomputed here
kinds.IMPORT: published result used exactly as published
kinds.POSTULATE: assumed; not derivable from the other nodes at present
kinds.INPUT: measured number that enters a choice or a formula
kinds.DERIVED: follows from PROVEN/IMPORT/POSTULATE/INPUT nodes and passes gates G1-G10
kinds.OBSERVATION: numerical agreement found after the target was known; not derived
kinds.FAILS: contradicted by a computation or by the record
kinds.CONJECTURE: open mathematical statement used as an assumption; listed wherever it is used
kinds.CONDITIONAL: theorem proved from PROVEN/IMPORT nodes plus at least one CONJECTURE
